title: Stay in the Water
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/GAT92irZekM (premise only: everyone must stay in water to survive)
summary: A lifeguard keeps a crowd safe in a swimming pool, because the infected will not step into water. Until the pump stops.

beats.text: I am a lifeguard. The night it began, sixty people ran into my pool.
Soaked and scared, they watched the infected press against the glass.
But they would not come in. Not one stepped into the water.
My one rule: everybody stays in the water, even to sleep.
We ate floating crackers from the snack bar. A grandmother taught us to float.
The infected waited three days, feet shuffling in the rain.
On the fourth night, the filter pump rattled and died.
The water began to sink an inch every hour.
By dawn it was knee deep. The infected edged toward the doorway.
The last inch drained. Behind me, someone whispered, "I am not bitten." I had counted sixty. Sixty-one voices answered.
